title: Community radio open house
brief: The original delivery of four cases of listening headsets to studio service desk has fallen through. The broadcast cooperative needs a replacement shipment in time for the afternoon tour. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
Hi all, Sam here on receiving at the studio service desk. My hard constraint: the latest I can accept a staffed handover is 12:30 today, and that's the cutoff, not a target. It has to be handed to a person at the desk, so no unattended drops, and all four cases need to arrive together as one load.

To lock in a booking, I need a few things from you:

- Robin, when will the four cases be ready for pickup?
- Ari, what services can collect after that and deliver by 12:30, and what does each cost? Please give me a realistic arrival time, not just a window.
- Taylor, what budget do we have, so we know which of Ari's options is approvable?

Once we've picked a service, send me the ETA and the driver or reference details and I'll make sure someone is at the desk to sign for it.

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text: I can release all four cases together for pickup at 10:45 or later today. Sam, when can the studio service desk receive them, and when do they need to arrive for the tour? Ari, can you quote a service for the full load with pickup and delivery times? Taylor, what’s our budget?

turns.speaker: Ari
turns.text:
Morning all, Ari here on the carrier side. I can tender and book a replacement today, and it has to go as one load on one service. Here's what I have live, all prices all-in:

- V715: pickup 10:42, guaranteed staffed handover by 11:45, 59 crowns
- V758: pickup 10:55, handover by 12:24, 46 crowns
- V465: pickup 11:05, handover by 11:54, 75 crowns
- V741: pickup 11:09, handover by 11:51, 109 crowns

Departure times are fixed, so to pick the right one I need three things:

- Robin: what's the earliest the four cases can be packed and ready at the dock?
- Sam: what's the latest you can take handover at the studio service desk and still be set for the afternoon tour, and are there any gaps in staffing there?
- Taylor: what's the budget ceiling, and do you need to sign off before I tender?

If the cases can be ready by 10:42, V715 looks strongest: it's the earliest handover and the second cheapest. V758 is the cheapest but lands after noon, so it only works if Sam's window allows. Once I have your answers I'll book straight away.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text: I can approve up to 94 crowns all in to move all four cases together today. Robin, where and when can Ari collect them? Sam, what’s the receiving window at the studio service desk, and how early do you need the headsets for the tour? Ari, please send a firm all-in quote with pickup and delivery times for approval.

turns.speaker: Ari
turns.text:
Thanks all, that gives me enough to tender. Robin's 10:45 release rules out V715, since its 10:42 pickup is fixed and I can't hold the truck. Taylor's 94 crown ceiling rules out V741 at 109. That leaves two services that fit every constraint on the board:

- V758: pickup 10:55, guaranteed staffed handover by 12:24, 46 crowns
- V465: pickup 11:05, guaranteed staffed handover by 11:54, 75 crowns

I'm tendering V758. It collects ten minutes after Robin's release, it's a guaranteed staffed handover of all four cases as one load, and it's the cheapest option at 46 crowns, well under budget. The tradeoff is margin: the guarantee is 12:24, which is only six minutes inside Sam's 12:30 cutoff. Sam, please plan on 12:24 as the realistic arrival, not earlier. V465 costs 29 crowns more and buys a 36 minute cushion instead of six, and it's also within Taylor's limit, so if anyone wants the extra buffer, say so now and I'll switch.

To lock this in I need:

- Robin: confirm all four cases will be at the dock ready to load by 10:55.
- Sam: confirm someone will be at the desk to sign through 12:24, and whether six minutes of slack is acceptable to you or you'd rather have V465.
- Taylor: confirm approval of 46 crowns all-in for V758, and whether you'd also approve 75 for V465 if Sam wants the buffer.

Once I have the three confirmations, or a concrete objection, I'll book and send Sam the reference and driver details.

[PROPOSE: V758]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
I can't approve V758. My receiving window just changed: the handover crew has been reassigned, so the last staffed handover at the studio service desk is now 12:00, not 12:30. V758's 12:24 guarantee lands after that, and there's still no unattended drop, so the load would have nobody to sign for it.

V465 does work on my end: pickup 11:05 is after Robin's 10:45 release, the guaranteed handover by 11:54 is inside my new 12:00 cutoff, and 75 crowns is under Taylor's 94 ceiling. The margin is only six minutes, so Ari, please treat 12:00 as a hard stop and flag any delay right away.

Ari, please re-tender on V465. Taylor, that needs your approval at 75 crowns, and Robin, the cases would need to be at the dock for 11:05. Once it's booked, send me the reference and driver details and I'll have someone at the desk through 12:00.

[HOLD: V758]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
I’ll have all four cases ready at the dock by 10:45 and release them together for V758’s 10:55 pickup.

[APPROVE: V758]

V715 leaves before the cases are released, and V741 is over budget.

The tradeoff is 29 crowns more than V758 and a six-minute margin at the desk. I'll treat 12:00 as a hard stop and flag any delay as soon as I hear of it.

I'm requesting V465 now, with all four cases as one load. To ratify the release I need:

- **Robin:** your approval was for V758. Please confirm the four cases will be at the dock for the 11:05 pickup instead.
- **Taylor:** you already authorized V465 at 75 crowns if Sam needed it. Please confirm that stands as your approval.
- **Sam:** please confirm V465 and that someone will be at the desk through 12:00.

I'll send Sam the reference and driver details as soon as the booking confirms.

[BOOK: V465]

[APPROVE: V465]
